notes:
Context:
- Mid-market analytics SaaS that powers in-product insights for B2B apps. Heavy mix of user-facing chat + realtime reranking of feature suggestions and nightly embedding pipelines for search personalization.
- Currently on another major LLM API provider + bespoke caching layer. Looking to migrate to Redwood for cost predictability and Dedicated capacity for peak loads.

Evaluation summary / objective:
- Short-term: validate Redwood Hosted API for parity and regression risk (two-week hosted POC).
- Mid-term: transition to Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable latency and throughput; requirement for VPC/private control plane for EU data.
- Key success metrics: prompt parity (NPS-like quality metric >= 0.95 vs baseline), p95 latency < 120ms for chat small prompts, reranker recall within 2% of baseline, embedding cost per vector reduced by >=20% with similar quality.

POC notes (hosted -> dedicated path):
- Week 1 (hosted): integration of Redwood SDK into staging; used compat layer shim to map existing API calls (minimal code changes).
- Week 2: ran side-by-side A/B on 10k chat sessions + 50k rerank ops. Observed: chat token latency improved in hosted by ~15% median, but reranker had edge-case regressions on long-context prompts.
- Prompt-parity issues: custom reranker scoring returned different ranking order for ~3.8% of test set; root cause suspected: subtle tokenization/IO rounding differences and sampling defaults. SE recommended deterministic sampling and tokenization mapping.
- Performance baseline: target throughput 200 req/s for chat, 300 qps for reranker bursts. Dedicated sizing estimate: 4xA100 equiv for peak 99th percentile with autoscale buffer.

Pricing conversations:
- They asked for detailed comparison vs incumbent spend (current monthly spend ~$18k). Initial Redwood hosted estimate for equivalent volume: ~$14k/mo (with optimize suggestions). Dedicated committed plan estimate: $6k-$10k/mo effective after 12-month commit (depending on burst credits).
- Procurement prefers a predictable committed model but wants a 60-day breaker if latency/regression thresholds not met. AE is pushing a pilot-dedicated with SLA guardrails + rollback path to hosted.

Security & compliance:
- Must support SSO/SAML (already in Redwood checklist).
- EU data residency waiver required for embeddings - legal wants explicit data flows and retention controls. KMS/HSM integration requested for encryption at rest keys.
- Audit logging must integrate with their Splunk instance; Redwood Console retention requirement: 90 days min for initial contract.

Technical risks / mitigation:
- Regressions on reranker: mitigation plan = narrow prompt tests + deterministic decoding + run eval harness on 100k query sample. SE to supply tokenization shim and run token-level diff. 
- Cost delta on embeddings: Redwood Optimize to run suggestion pass (quantization + batching) and present simulated monthly bills.
- Migration friction: build a compatibility shim library that maps their current API verbosities to Redwood hosted endpoints; roadmap includes automated tests for parity.

Timeline / recent activity:

- 2026-01-22: Technical discovery with engineering + SE (Priya) — agreed to hosted POC.

- 2026-03-10: Pricing review call; requested written committed pricing and 60-day breaker clause.
